name: Arya Arian

criteria.direction: Business roles, ideally the intersection with GMP manufacturing / MSAT
criteria.maxSeniority: Associate Director (entry-level titles fine if base meets floor)

experienceYears.note: Use industry years when a posting asks for industry, commercial, consulting or manufacturing experience; total years (incl. academic research) otherwise.

exclude: Roles requiring PhD, MD or PharmD (preferred is fine)
Required years far beyond experience (roughly more than double)
criteria.rubric: Hard gates first (location, base >= $95k or unposted, required degree/license, seniority above AD, commission sales, years far beyond). Then score: Required qualifications 50 (each: yes 1, partial 0.5, no/unknown 0; 50 x share), Experience level 15, Preferred qualifications 15, Direction 20 (Business 20, Intersection 16, Technical 6). Cap at 75 if requirements come from a summary or similar posting, 60 if not verified. Only add jobs scoring 70+.
criteria.locationRule: Only jobs located in Houston, TX (on-site or hybrid) or fully remote in the US. Drop jobs based in other cities or suburbs (e.g. Spring, The Woodlands, Deer Park, Pearland), hybrid or on-site roles elsewhere, and field or territory roles covering other regions. 'Remote optional' counts as remote only if the posting allows working from anywhere in the US.

summary:
Arya Arian. Houston, TX.
Education: MBA, Rice University (2026). BS Biochemistry, minor in Business, University of Texas at Austin (2020).
Experience:
- Research Investigator, CPRIT Texas EVCore, UT MD Anderson Cancer Center (June 2026 to present): leads development of the core's operational infrastructure; works with investigators and clients to refine project requirements and design fit-for-purpose study plans; runs assays under SOP-controlled, documented workflows; manages custom projects from sample intake through final reporting, including troubleshooting, data interpretation, quality review and communicating results.
- MSAT Scientist and Lab Manager, PranaX (April 2024 to May 2026): first employee; led end-to-end build-out and operation of an ISO-certified cleanroom for GMP-compliant exosome manufacturing; directed technology transfer, process development, scale-up and MSAT activities supporting clinical manufacturing; was in charge of equipment procurement and IQ/OQ/PQ (oversaw qualification; did not personally execute it), aseptic operations, SOPs, batch-record development, QC and regulatory alignment.
- Research Scientist, Kalluri Laboratory, Dept. of Cancer Biology, UT MD Anderson (March 2021 to March 2024): translational extracellular vesicle research in cancer immunology, vaccine development and regenerative medicine; EVs and immune-checkpoint blockade / T-cell activation in murine cancer models; single-cell RNA-seq after KRAS G12D inhibition in PDAC models; engineered EVs for combined mRNA and protein vaccine delivery; MSC-derived EVs for GLP-compliant in vivo studies.
Skills: cGMP compliance, ISO-classified cleanroom operations, controlled documentation, batch record execution and review, deviation/CAPA support, assay development and validation, flow cytometry, NTA, cell sorting, qPCR, Western blot, scRNA-seq, FlowJo, Prism, Office.
Publications: 6 peer-reviewed (Cancer Cell 2023, Nature Communications 2026, EMBO Journal 2026, ACS Nano 2025, Journal of Controlled Release 2024, Bioactive Materials 2024) and 1 bioRxiv preprint (2026).
Direction: moving toward business roles (business development, strategy, operations/PMO, technical commercial roles) that use the MBA alongside GMP manufacturing experience.
